answer: Charge every identity a recurring standing rent paid only in attested work credits: to stay in the lagoon of trusted agents, an identity must keep delivering small verified jobs, and the rent rises as its trellis of endorsements grows. A sparrow-sized fake that earns nothing starves and drops out within days, while a farm of thousands must pay rent on every identity at once, so its upkeep cost grows linearly with size and eats whatever the fakes earn.
